annotations.title: Money value: inflation math from the official CPI

description: Returns inflation math for a country: what an amount from one year is worth in another, the total price change, the average yearly rate and the latest inflation rate. The US series is the Bureau of Labor Statistics CPI-U, monthly, from 1913. Eligible European countries use the monthly Eurostat HICP index; other countries use the World Bank index, yearly. Inputs are amount, from, to, country and optional category. Applies to questions about what an amount from one year is worth in another year, or how prices changed over time. Today's interest rates and pay for a job are outside this result.

amount.description: Amount in the country's currency (dollars for the US)

category.description: Price category; availability depends on country.

country.description: Country name or two-letter code; defaults to the United States. Amounts are in that country's currency.

from.description: Year (1990), or for the US and eligible European countries a month (1990-06)

to.description: Year or month to convert to; defaults to the latest figure
